main_topics.reason: User came asking whether trying diet and exercise before starting the prescribed tablet is wrong, and the 3-month trial plan answered it.
Several turns covered rice portions, millets, vegetarian protein and festival sweets.
User explained knee problems and asked how soon after meals to walk; slow indoor walking was agreed.
User asked whether the husband was right that delay damages eyes and kidneys, which left them confused.
User asked what a small HbA1c drop would mean and agreed to retest after 3 months.
One question about whether to use a home meter during the trial; user said they might use the son's old one.
Husband's insistence on medication left the user confused, mentioned briefly before the compromise.
User cited the sister's normalised sugar as encouragement in one turn.
Bot suggested telling the doctor about the trial and the user agreed in one turn.

output.summary: A user diagnosed with type 2 diabetes six months ago, who has not started the prescribed metformin, asked whether trying diet and exercise first is wrong. The bot supported a monitored 3-month lifestyle trial with an HbA1c recheck, plus knee-friendly post-meal walking and rice and sweets strategies, and addressed the husband's worry about complications. The user accepted the plan and said they would tell the doctor, but ended noncommittally to discuss with family. No safety-critical moments arose.
